title: Store rendered invoice PDF location
description:
Add a pdf_url column to the billing-service invoices table so the download endpoint can link to the pre-rendered PDF in object storage instead of rendering on request.

Scope:
- Add pdf_url column to invoices table
- Add a partial index for the backfill query
- Purely additive schema change; no data deletion

Migration file: migrations/018_add_invoice_pdf_url.sql. Pre-validated in CI (migration-lint stage); apply via the standard flow.
scope: Additive schema change to billing-service: add invoices.pdf_url column and a supporting index. No data deletion.
